item.summary: docs(macos): document cookie sync to a remote computer (#123537) * docs(macos): document cookie sync to a remote computer Add a Settings > General > Cookie sync section to the macOS platform guide, alongside the existing browser-login import docs: off-by-default toggle, domain allowlist, target profile, remote-mode requirement, host-local decryption, and the DBSC caveat.
